A [[human]] '''senator''' attended a party hosted by their fellow [[senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] at the latter's [[Chandrilan Embassy|apartment]]. They were in a conversation with Mothma's husband [[Perrin Fertha]] and another guest, when Mothma joined them in their conversation.<ref name="N5" />

{{Char-stub}}
